name: Pastoruri glacier
region: Huascarán National Park, southern Cordillera Blanca
why: A short, very high walk to the front of a disappearing tropical glacier and its meltwater lake, at about 5,000 m.
book: Huascarán National Park ticket (one day: S/30 for foreigners in 2023). 70 km south of Huaraz via Cátac and the Pachacoto valley, where the road passes the Puya raimondii stands; most visitors come on a day tour from Huaraz.
water: None: carry 1 litre and something warm to drink.
dangers: About 5,000 m at the glacier: come acclimatised (Laguna Churup or Wilcacocha first) and walk slowly.
Do not walk on the ice or touch the glacier: its front is retreating and breaks off.
Cold wind, sleet and strong sun, often on the same day.
turnaround: Headache, dizziness or breathlessness on the path: turn back to the car park, it only gets worse higher up.

points.name: Pastoruri car park
points.note: End of the road at about 4,800 m. A marked path climbs gently south over bare rock left by the ice.

points.name: Pastoruri glacier viewpoint
points.note: The glacier front above its new meltwater lake, about 5,000 m. Look, do not touch; back the same way.
